title: Powertoys doesn't open, only shows up in tray as a icon
summary: The tray icon appears, but Settings does not open. A diagnostic report was supplied and a maintainer identified a Settings process crash.
next_action: Correlate the existing Settings crash event with application logs, then compare startup in a fresh profile and an equivalent VM.

judgment.rationale: The report and the maintainer's extracted crash event identify the affected process and build; the failing startup component is not established.
judgment.recommended_action: Use the supplied report before asking the reporter for another archive.

fix_assessment.rationale: The reported crash signature does not establish a root cause or yet justify an implementation change.

reproduce.title: Compare Settings launch and the already-reported crash signature
reproduce.version_requirement: PowerToys 0.102.3101.0 and the latest supported stable build as a control
prerequisites: Disposable Windows VM and existing report linked in the issue thread.
setup: Match the Windows build from the report where practical. Do not copy the reporter's profile or configuration into a shared environment.
steps: Correlate the supplied Application Error event with the last Settings startup log entry in the existing report.
Start PowerToys in a fresh VM profile, verify the tray remains responsive, and open Settings from the tray menu.
If Settings exits, record the first application-owned failing frame or log event and compare the signature against the supplied report and the stable-build control.
reproduce.expected_result: Settings opens while the tray runner remains active. A failed launch produces a matched crash signature or a distinct signature to triage separately.

issue_context.summary: The Settings window does not open although the PowerToys tray icon is present.
known_information: The report concerns a Windows VM and PowerToys 0.102.3101. A later comment supplied the requested report.
inferences: The active tray icon and Settings crash event point to Settings startup rather than the runner failing to launch.
issue_context.analysis: The maintainer excerpt names PowerToys.Settings.exe with exception 0x80131506. A fault surfaced through KERNELBASE.dll does not by itself identify the failing component. Do not conflate this with other Settings launch reports solely on symptoms.
initial_investigation: Read the report and subsequent maintainer crash summary; no local runtime reproduction was performed.
information_gaps: The first failing startup operation and whether the same signature occurs in a clean profile remain unknown.

status.label: Needs Maintainer Verification
status.detail: The requested report is already available; use it to identify the startup failure before proposing a fix.
